info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Customer Behavior Model-spec
info.description: The Customer Behavior Modeling API enables businesses to create and manage customer behavior models that can drive strategic decision-making and enhance marketing efforts. This API allows users to submit detailed specifications for new models that analyze customer interactions and habits. Typical consumers include data analysts and marketing teams looking to leverage insights for more targeted campaigns. By utilizing this API, organizations can gain a deeper understanding of their customer base and improve engagement strategies.

post.summary: Create a new customer behavior model.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new customer behavior model by providing the necessary parameters in the request body. It is designed to help you build and analyze models that can predict customer behaviors based on various data inputs.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a new customer behavior model. This body should include all necessary parameters to define the model's characteristics and behavior based on customer interactions.

201.description: The customer behavior model was created successfully.
